original_card.first_experiment: Choose one assumption ID (native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape, analytic_recovery), one quantified implication and exact dependency closure. actual_scope: For n = 2^g - 1 (g >= 3), the maximum number of mass-floor(log2 n) leaf-destination error channels at one cut and register of PR628's balanced dirty word, and the resulting k-error envelope bound; the case excluded by PR2177 PROOF3 Theorem M3.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a caller-bound proof of an inherited assumption. This package proves a smaller all-size transport proposition in the uniform-transfer lineage of PR2177, which states it only by census. It does not discharge any of the five selected assumptions.
bottleneck_link: Side result in the destination-error transport lineage (PR1416, PR2067, PR2177). It sharpens a proved k-error amplification envelope; no precision invoice, supplier or kappa changes.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved upper bound for all g >= 3 with exact finite corroboration; leave attainment for all g and lower mass levels open.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the written proof. verify.py checks the word against PR2177 check2.gen (n <= 64), Lemma G (h <= 5), Lemma P2 (h = 2..5), all class bounds and the exact maximum 4g - 3 for g = 3..6, and two failing controls.
